question: Ground one artifact-download redirect policy without guessing an observed account hostname.

primary_sources.title: GitHub REST API: Download an artifact
supported_facts: The artifact ZIP endpoint returns HTTP302 with a Location for the download.
The returned download URL expires after one minute.
The endpoint requires Actions repository read permission for a private artifact.

primary_sources.title: GitHub self-hosted runners: accessible domains by function
supported_facts: GitHub documents *.blob.core.windows.net among endpoints needed for uploading/downloading workflow artifacts, job summaries, logs and caches.
The document lists results-receiver.actions.githubusercontent.com too; this selected download-redirect policy does not admit that host or arbitrary actions domains.

primary_sources.title: GitHub private networking: domain lists
supported_facts: GitHub describes more specific published domain lists via its public meta endpoint.
No exact storage-account list or exact Location was recovered through the available web response, so none is claimed or pinned.

retained_metadata_findings.limitation: The existing provider metadata and raw-custody receipt do not expose the GitHub redirect Location. Connector attachment storage must not be mistaken for GitHub's artifact storage.

selected_policy.authority: Root selection for revised protocol review under standing mandate; no implementation or execution admission.
selected_policy.source: The one302 Location returned by the TLS-authenticated exact api.github.com artifact ZIP endpoint for the frozen artifact ID.
selected_policy.target_host: Exactly one nonempty ASCII account/DNS label followed by .blob.core.windows.net; no nested label, IP literal, alternative suffix, trailing dot, Unicode/IDNA substitution, userinfo or malformed authority.
selected_policy.host_comparison: Parse once using strict URL validation; compare a canonical lowercase ASCII hostname. Do not follow unexpected hosts before requesting them.
selected_policy.credentials: No Authorization, cookies, API-specific credentials or Referer forwarded; create an explicit fresh unauthenticated request rather than inherit headers.
selected_policy.tls: Default certificate and hostname verification; no trust/verification changes.
selected_policy.url_restrictions: No fragment, userinfo, downgrade or second redirect. Keep the provider-supplied signed path/query only in memory for that one request; do not log or persist the signed URL.
selected_policy.path_policy: No speculative path-prefix pin. Relation to the frozen artifact is supplied by the authenticated exact endpoint's Location plus final exact ZIP size and SHA256.
selected_policy.final_response: HTTP200 only; enforce frozen HTTP response-body and time caps, and exact 83342-byte ZIP/SHA256 before success.
selected_policy.unsupported_response: Fail closed before another GET for any disallowed host/URL, missing Location, second redirect or other status.

research_method: Read-only local provider metadata plus public primary GitHub documentation. A public meta documentation endpoint was viewed; no actual runner or artifact endpoint was exercised.
